interpretation.supported_claim: At 2,328 persisted parts, lazy development staging and reuse of one insertion-ordered validated part-resource matrix reduced Biosphere.advance cost while producing exact full world and chemistry snapshots over the paired continuation.
interpretation.development_boundary: No growth proposal committed during these 12 steps; the measured _develop improvement is the common no-proposal path. The optimized proposal path still stages a shallow mapping only after resource validation and appends new immutable records transactionally.
interpretation.reason: The 6.22x figure covers only neutral physics plus Biosphere phases under cProfile. It excludes neural inference, fields, rendering, server work, and other Habitat3D phases, so it is not a whole-runtime or live-world speedup.
